I am a **PhD researcher** at the [MAKIS Project](https://www.projet-makis.org/), member of the [UMI SOURCE](https://www.umi-source.uvsq.fr/) ([University Paris-Saclay](https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/en)).

I am a **development and public economist**. My research focuses on the adoption of **agricultural innovation** and the **risk management mechanisms** in Madagascar.

I'm Working on my thesis at the [Economics departement - EGS Faculty - University of Antananarivo](https://www.univ-antananarivo.mg/) since February 2022. under the supervision of [Holimalala Randriamanampisoa](https://www.umi-source.uvsq.fr/holimalala-marcelle-randriamanampisoa) and [Claire Gondard](https://www.umi-source.uvsq.fr/mme-claire-gondard-delcroix).

You can contact me at my [email adress](mailto:andri.joed@gmail.com).

## News

I will be in Androy Madagascar from May to June 2026 to conduct fieldwork about the third chapter of my thesis within the [DYNATSIMO](https://www.umi-source.uvsq.fr/dynatsimo-resilience) project (Understanding and assessing development dynamics in the Greater South of Madagascar).
